Online training game that teaches farmers and traders what it takes to run a successful livestock offtaking business in Kenya. Players pick from all 47 counties, each with its own risk profile, then work through capital, recruitment, operations and crisis phases before being scored — with a shared leaderboard and session analytics for facilitators.
